Know me, Partha (son of Pritha), as the chief of household priests, Brihaspati; among generals I am Skanda; among bodies of water I am the ocean.
Among the great seers I am Bhrigu; among words I am the one syllable (Om); among sacrifices I am the sacrifice of quiet repetition; among things that stand still, the Himalaya.

cmp.note: akṣara 同时是「音节」和「不灭」。「言语中我是那一个音节」也可以听成「那一个不灭者」。白话「音节」、英文 syllable 都只能取一边。

verses.en: Among all trees I am the ashvattha (the sacred fig); among divine seers, Narada; among the gandharvas (heavenly musicians), Chitraratha; among the perfected ones, the sage Kapila.

cmp.note: aśvattha 就是毕钵罗树，后来佛陀在这种树下成道，才有了「菩提树」的名字。白话直接写「菩提树」，中文读者会想到佛教；《薄伽梵歌》这里没有这层意思，英文写 sacred fig。

verses.en: Among horses know me as Uchchaihshravas, born of the nectar; among lordly elephants, Airavata; and among men, the king.
Among weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows, the wish-granting cow; among those who beget, I am Kandarpa, the god of love; among serpents I am Vasuki.
Among the nagas (serpent beings) I am Ananta; among the creatures of the waters, Varuna; among the ancestors, Aryaman; among those who hold others in check, I am Yama.

cmp.note: 这是个文字游戏：Yama（阎摩）的名字来自动词 yam「约束」，saṃyamatām 是「约束者们」。「约束者中我是约束」，梵文一听就懂；白话「执法者」、英文 hold others in check 只能保住意思，保不住谐音。

verses.en: Among the Daityas (demon sons of Diti) I am Prahlada; among those who reckon, I am time; among beasts, the king of beasts; among birds, Garuda, son of Vinata.

cmp.note: 又一个谐音：kāla「时间」和 kal「计算」同音近义，时间本来就是最会「算账」的。白话「计算者中我是时间」意思到了，音没了。kāla 这个词到第十一章还会以更可怕的面目出现。

verses.en: Among purifiers I am the wind; among those who bear arms, Rama; among sea creatures, the makara; among rivers I am the Ganges (Jahnavi).
Of all creations I am the beginning, the end and the middle too, Arjuna. Of all kinds of knowledge I am knowledge of the self; in those who debate, I am the reasoning that seeks the truth.
Among letters I am the letter A; among compounds, the pairing compound. I alone am time that never runs out; I am the creator whose faces turn every way.

cmp.note: dvandva 是语法术语：把两个词并列成「甲和乙」的复合词。同一个词在本经别处指「冷热、苦乐这类成对的对立」。白话、英文都只能译出语法这一层。

verses.en: I am death that carries everything off, and the coming forth of all that is yet to be. Among the feminine I am fame, fortune, speech, memory, wisdom, steadfastness and patience.

cmp.note: 字面是「在女人之中」，后面列的七个词在梵文里都是阴性名词，也常被当成女神。白话写「阴性的事物」、英文写 among the feminine，都绕开了「女人」这个直译。

verses.en: Among the chants I am the Brihat-saman; among meters, the Gayatri; among months, Margashirsha (around November to December); among seasons, the flower-bringing spring.
Of cheats I am the dice game; of the brilliant, their brilliance. I am victory, I am resolve, I am the goodness of the good.

cmp.note: 「欺诈中我是赌博」听来刺耳。整部《摩诃婆罗多》的战争，正是从般度族在一场作弊的掷骰赌局里输掉王国开始的。这一层背景，白话和英文都要靠读者自己知道。

verses.en: Among the Vrishnis I am Vasudeva; among the Pandavas, Dhananjaya (winner of wealth); among sages I am Vyasa; among poets, the poet Ushana.
Of those who tame I am the rod; of those who seek victory, wise policy; of secrets, I am silence; of the knowing, I am knowledge.
And whatever is the seed of all beings, that is me, Arjuna. Nothing that moves or stands still could exist without me.
There is no end to my divine powers, scorcher of foes. What I have told you is only a sketch of how far they reach.
Whatever being has power, splendor or strength, know that it has sprung from a mere spark of my brilliance.
But what good is all this detail to you, Arjuna? I hold up this whole world with a single fragment of myself, and remain.

chapters.title: Chapter 11 · The Vision of the Universal Form

verses.en: (Arjuna said:) Out of kindness to me you have spoken the deepest secret, the teaching about the self, and through your words this confusion of mine has gone.
Lotus-eyed one, I have heard from you at length how beings arise and pass away, and of your greatness that never fades.
It is just as you have said of yourself, supreme Lord. Yet, highest of persons, I long to see your form as the Lord of all.
Lord, if you think it possible for me to see it, then, master of yoga, show me your imperishable self.
(The Blessed Lord said:) Look, Partha, at my forms, by the hundred and by the thousand, of many kinds, divine, of many colors and shapes.
Look at the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the twin Ashvins and the Maruts. Look, Bharata (descendant of Bharata), at many wonders never seen before.
Here, today, see the whole universe, all that moves and all that is still, gathered in one place in my body, Gudakesha, and anything else you wish to see.
But you cannot see me with these eyes of yours. I give you a divine eye: see my yoga as the Lord.

cmp.note: 梵文「神圣的眼睛」。白话「天眼」是佛教熟词，中文读者会想到「天眼通」；英文 divine eye 没有这层联想。

verses.en: (Sanjaya said:) Having spoken this, O king (Dhritarashtra), the great lord of yoga, Hari, then showed Partha his supreme form as the Lord.
It had countless mouths and eyes, countless marvelous sights, countless divine ornaments, countless divine weapons raised;
it wore divine garlands and garments and was anointed with divine perfumes, all made of wonder: God, without end, facing every way.
If the light of a thousand suns were to rise in the sky all at once, that might come near the light of that great being.
There, in the body of the god of gods, the son of Pandu saw the whole universe, divided in so many ways, standing together as one.
Then Dhananjaya, overcome with wonder, the hair on his body standing up, bowed his head to the god, joined his palms, and spoke.

cmp.note: 梵文「毛发竖起」，在印度诗里常是又惊又喜、全身发麻的感觉。白话「汗毛直竖」在中文里多半指害怕；英文只写 hair standing up，把是惊是喜留给读者。

verses.en: (Arjuna said:) I see the gods in your body, O God, and all the kinds of beings gathered in crowds: Brahma the lord seated on his lotus, all the seers, and the divine serpents.
I see you everywhere, endless in form, with countless arms, bellies, mouths and eyes. I see no end of you, no middle, and no beginning either, lord of all, whose form is the universe.

cmp.note: viśva-rūpa 是本章的核心词：「以一切为形」或「有一切形状的」。白话写「以宇宙为形相者」，英文写 whose form is the universe；梵文 viśva 是「一切」，比「宇宙」更直白。

verses.en: I see you wearing a crown, bearing a mace and a discus, a mass of radiance blazing on every side, hard to look at, all around you the glare of burning fire and sun, beyond measure.

You are the Imperishable, the highest thing to be known; you are the final resting place of this universe. You never fade; you guard the everlasting dharma (the order of things). You are, I believe, the eternal person.

cmp.note: dharma 来自 dhṛ「撑住」，是把世界和社会撑住的秩序，落到个人身上就是「本分」。本站英文在讲个人时译 duty，这里讲宇宙就写 order of things；白话写「正法」，是借了佛教词，意思偏向「真理、正道」。

verses.en: I see you without beginning, middle or end, of endless power, with endless arms, the sun and moon for eyes, your mouth a blazing sacrificial fire, scorching this whole universe with your own heat.
The space between heaven and earth, and every direction, is filled by you alone. Seeing this wondrous, terrible form of yours, great one, the three worlds tremble.

cmp.note: 「三个世界」在吠陀里是天、空、地。白话「三界」是佛教词，指欲界、色界、无色界，中文读者容易套错。英文 three worlds 中性一些。

verses.en: Those crowds of gods are entering into you; some, afraid, praise you with joined palms. Crowds of great seers and perfected ones cry 'May it be well!' and praise you with hymns in abundance.

The Rudras, Adityas, Vasus and Sadhyas, the All-gods, the two Ashvins, the Maruts and the steam-drinkers, crowds of gandharvas, yakshas, asuras and perfected ones: all of them gaze at you in amazement.

cmp.note: 字面是「喝热气的人」，指祖先的灵魂：他们只享用祭食冒出的热气。白话直接写「祖灵」，意思对，但这个古怪而生动的说法丢了。

verses.en: Seeing your vast form, mighty-armed one, with its many mouths and eyes, many arms, thighs and feet, many bellies, fearsome with many tusks, the worlds tremble, and so do I.
When I see you touching the sky, blazing, many-colored, mouths gaping, huge eyes on fire, my innermost self is shaken, Vishnu, and I find no steadiness and no peace.

cmp.note: 阿周那在这里改口叫「毗湿奴啊」。前面一直是朋友般的称呼，此刻他看见的正是大神毗湿奴的本相，称呼一变，关系也变了。白话仍写「黑天」，这个转折看不出来；英文照原文写 Vishnu。

verses.en: Just seeing your mouths, fearsome with tusks, like the fire at the end of time, I lose all sense of direction and find no shelter. Have mercy, lord of gods, home of the universe!

cmp.note: 字面是「时间之火」，指一个宇宙周期结束时烧尽一切的那场大火。白话「世界末日之火」带了西方「末日」的味道；印度的「终结」是循环的，烧完还会重来。英文写 fire at the end of time，保住了「时间」这个字。

verses.en: And all these sons of Dhritarashtra, together with crowds of kings, Bhishma, Drona and that charioteer's son (Karna), and the chief warriors on our own side too,
are rushing into your fearsome mouths, terrible with tusks. Some are seen caught between your teeth, their heads crushed to powder.
As the many rushing currents of rivers race toward the one ocean, so these heroes of the world of men pour into your blazing mouths.
As moths fly at full speed into a blazing fire to their death, so the worlds fly at full speed into your mouths to their death.
Swallowing all the worlds from every side with your flaming mouths, you lick your lips. Your fierce rays fill the whole universe with brilliance and scorch it, Vishnu.
Tell me who you are, with this terrible form. Homage to you, best of gods; have mercy! I want to understand you, the first one, for I do not understand what you are doing.
(The Blessed Lord said:) I am time, grown ripe, the destroyer of worlds, come here to gather the worlds in. Even without you, none of these warriors drawn up in the opposing ranks will live on.

cmp.note: kāla 同时是「时间」「死亡的时刻」和「黑色」，而 Kṛṣṇa 这个名字本义也是「黑」。白话、英文都译「时间」，这是对的：神说的是时间本身就在吞人。英语世界流传的那句 I am become Death，把它换成了「死亡」，比原文更直接也更窄。
动词 sam-ā-hṛ 是「收拢、收回」，像把摊开的东西收起来。白话「收拾众生」带着一点狠劲，英文 gather in 更接近「收回」的本义。

verses.en: So stand up and win glory. Conquer your enemies and enjoy a thriving kingdom. They have already been struck down by me; be no more than the instrument, Savyasachin (you who can shoot with either hand).

cmp.note: nimitta 是「起因、契机、标记」，不完全是「工具」。神说的是：你只是让这件事发生的那个由头。白话「工具」、英文 instrument 都比原词更像被拿在手里的东西。

verses.en: Drona and Bhishma, Jayadratha and Karna, and the other heroic warriors too, I have already slain. Kill them; do not be shaken. Fight! You will defeat your rivals in battle.
(Sanjaya said:) Hearing these words of Keshava, the crowned one, trembling, palms joined, bowed and spoke once more to Krishna, stammering, terrified, bowing low.
(Arjuna said:) It is fitting, Hrishikesha, that the world rejoices and delights in your praise; the rakshasas flee in terror in every direction, and all the crowds of perfected ones bow down.

cmp.note: Hṛṣīkeśa 常被解成「感官之主」（hṛṣīka 是感官），也有人解成「头发竖起的人」。这句开头正是 prahṛṣyati「欢喜得发抖」，和称号同根，是个暗中的呼应，白话「黑天」、英文都留不住。

verses.en: And why should they not bow to you, great one? You are greater even than Brahma, the first maker. Endless one, lord of gods, home of the universe, you are the Imperishable: what is, what is not, and what lies beyond them both.

cmp.note: brahmaṇaḥ 可以是创世神「梵天」（Brahmā），也可以是那个无形的「梵」（brahman）。前面又说「最初的创造者」，所以白话和英文都读成梵天；另一种读法是「你比梵还大」，意思就完全不同了。

verses.en: You are the first god, the ancient person, the final resting place of this universe. You are the knower and what is to be known, and the highest dwelling. By you the universe is spread out, you of endless form.

You are Vayu (wind), Yama, Agni (fire), Varuna, the moon, Prajapati (lord of creatures), and the great-grandfather. Homage, homage to you a thousand times, and again, and once more, homage, homage to you!

cmp.note: 梵天常被称为众生的「祖父」（pitāmaha），这里叫克里希那「曾祖父」，意思是他连梵天的源头也是。白话写「始祖」，这层「比祖父还早一辈」的辈分感没了。

verses.en: Homage to you in front and behind, homage to you on every side, you who are all. Your strength is endless, your might beyond measure; you take in everything, and so you are everything.
Whatever I said rashly, thinking of you as a friend, 'Hey, Krishna! Hey, Yadava! Hey, friend!', not knowing this greatness of yours, through carelessness or simply out of affection,

and however I may have slighted you in jest, at play, lying down, sitting or at meals, alone, Achyuta (unshaken one), or in front of others, for all of that I ask you, who are beyond measure, to forgive me.

You are the father of this world of moving and unmoving things, the one it should worship, its weightiest teacher. There is no one equal to you in the three worlds; how could there be anyone greater, you whose power has no match?

cmp.note: guru 本义是「重」，garīyān 是「更重」。「最重的重者」在梵文里是个双关：既是分量，也是尊贵。英文 weightiest teacher 留住了一点「重」；白话「最尊贵的导师」只剩下尊贵。

verses.en: So I bow down, laying my body before you, and ask you, the Lord worthy of praise, to be gracious. As a father bears with a son, a friend with a friend, a lover with the beloved, so please bear with me, God.
I am thrilled to have seen what was never seen before, yet my mind shakes with fear. Show me, God, that form of yours. Have mercy, lord of gods, home of the universe.
I want to see you just as before, crowned, holding the mace, discus in hand. Take on that four-armed form again, you of a thousand arms, whose body is the universe.

(The Blessed Lord said:) Arjuna, because I am pleased with you, I have shown you this supreme form by my own yoga: made of brilliance, all-embracing, endless, primal. No one but you has ever seen it before.

cmp.note: 阿周那一直在求 prasīda「请息怒、请开恩」，这里神回答 prasannena「我是心平气和、欢喜地」，两个词同根。白话「欢喜」、英文 pleased 都译对了，但前后呼应只在梵文里听得见。

verses.en: Not through the Vedas or sacrifice, not through study or gifts, not through rituals or fierce austerities can I be seen in this form in the world of men by anyone but you, hero of the Kurus.
Do not be afraid, and do not be bewildered at seeing this terrible form of mine. Put away fear, be glad at heart, and look once more at that familiar form of mine: here it is.
(Sanjaya said:) Having spoken thus to Arjuna, Vasudeva showed his own form once more; the great one, taking again a gentle body, comforted the frightened Arjuna.
Arjuna said: Seeing this gentle human form of yours, Janardana, I have now come to my senses; I am myself again.

cmp.note: 字面是「回到了本性」。prakṛti 在这里是日常意思「常态、本来样子」，到第十三章却成了哲学术语「原质」。白话「恢复了常态」、英文 I am myself again 都译得自然，只是看不出这是同一个词。

verses.en: (The Blessed Lord said:) This form of mine that you have seen is very hard to see. Even the gods long always for a sight of it.
Not through the Vedas, not through austerity, not through gifts, not through sacrifice can I be seen as you have seen me.
But through devotion that turns to nothing else, Arjuna, I can be known in this way, and seen as I truly am, and entered into, scorcher of foes.

cmp.note: bhakti 来自 bhaj「分得一份、归属于」，原意是「我属于你、你也在我这里」的相属，后来才有热烈爱慕的意思。白话「虔爱」把敬与爱都放进去了；英文 devotion 偏重忠诚投入，「爱」的一面要靠上下文补。

verses.en: Whoever does my work, holds me as the highest, is devoted to me, is free of attachment, and bears ill will toward no being, comes to me, son of Pandu.
(Arjuna said:) There are those who are always joined to you and worship you with devotion, and there are those who worship the Imperishable, the Unmanifest. Which of them knows yoga better?

cmp.note: avyakta 是「没有显露出来的」，指没有形象可见的那个终极。白话加了括号「（梵）」帮读者对上号，原文没有点名；英文写 the Unmanifest，照原文留白。

verses.en: (The Blessed Lord said:) Those who fix their minds on me and worship me, always joined to me, filled with the highest faith: these I hold to be the most fully joined in yoga.

cmp.note: śraddhā 原意是「把心放上去」，是信任、托付，而不是「相信某条教义」。白话「信心」比较接近；英文 faith 容易被读成宗教信条。

verses.en: But those who worship the Imperishable, which cannot be pointed out, the Unmanifest, present everywhere, beyond thought, standing firm at the summit, unmoving and constant,

cmp.note: kūṭa 是「山顶」，也是铁匠的「砧子」；kūṭastha 就是像砧子那样任凭锤打而自己不动。白话「恒常不变」把画面去掉了，英文 standing firm at the summit 保住了一半。

verses.en: who hold all their senses in check, keep an even mind toward everything, and take delight in the good of all beings: they too reach me.
Yet the struggle is greater for those whose minds cling to the Unmanifest, for the unmanifest way is hard for those who have bodies to travel.
But those who lay down all their actions in me, who hold me as the highest, who meditate on me with a yoga that turns to nothing else, and worship me,
for them, whose minds have entered into me, I soon become the one who lifts them out of the ocean of death and rebirth, Partha.

cmp.note: saṃsāra 字面是「流转、四处漂」，指一次次生死不停。白话「生死轮回」用了佛教熟词；英文 death and rebirth 说得直白，没有「流动」的画面。

verses.en: Set your mind on me alone; let your understanding enter into me. From then on you will dwell in me alone. Of this there is no doubt.
If you cannot hold your thought steady on me, then, Dhananjaya, seek to reach me through the yoga of practice.
If you cannot even practice, then make my work your highest aim. Simply by doing actions for my sake, you will reach fulfillment.
And if you cannot do even this, then rely on my yoga, rein yourself in, and let go of the fruits of all your actions.

cmp.note: 「舍弃行为的果报」不是叫人不做事，而是照做，但不把成败据为己有。karma 在本站英文统一译 action，白话译「行为」，都避开了中文里「业报」那种因果报应的味道。

verses.en: For knowledge is better than practice; meditation is better than knowledge; letting go of the fruits of action is better than meditation; and from letting go, peace follows at once.
One who hates no being, who is friendly and compassionate, free of 'mine' and of 'I', the same in pain and pleasure, patient,

cmp.note: maitra「友善」和 karuṇa「悲悯」，正是佛教「慈、悲」两个词的梵文原形。白话「友善而慈悲」、英文 friendly and compassionate 都译对了，只是中文读者看到「慈悲」会以为是佛教借词。
ahaṃkāra 字面是「造出『我』的东西」，指那种「这是我做的」的感觉。白话「我慢」是佛教词，现代中文读者会读成「傲慢」；英文写 free of 'I'，更接近字面。

verses.en: always content, a yogi, self-controlled, firm in resolve, whose mind and understanding are offered to me, who is devoted to me: that one is dear to me.
One before whom the world does not shrink, and who does not shrink before the world, who is free of elation, resentment, fear and agitation: that one too is dear to me.
One who expects nothing, who is clean, capable, unconcerned, untroubled, who has given up every undertaking, who is devoted to me: that one is dear to me.

cmp.note: 字面是「放下一切开头、一切发起」。白话加了「刻意的营谋」，把它解释得比较温和；英文照字面写 every undertaking，读者会自己问：难道什么都不做？这个张力在原文里就有。

verses.en: One who neither rejoices nor hates, neither grieves nor craves, who has let go of both the welcome and the unwelcome, full of devotion: that one is dear to me.

cmp.note: śubha / aśubha 是「吉利的、不吉利的」，也就是人碰到的顺境逆境，不一定是道德上的善恶。白话「善与恶」容易被读成「连好坏都不分」；英文写 the welcome and the unwelcome。

verses.en: The same toward enemy and friend, the same in honor and dishonor, the same in cold and heat, in pleasure and pain, free from attachment,
taking blame and praise alike, sparing with words, content with whatever comes, without a settled home, steady in mind, full of devotion: such a person is dear to me.
But those who, with faith, holding me as the highest, devoted to me, follow this nectar of dharma just as I have taught it, are dearer to me than all.

chapters.title: Chapter 13 · The Yoga of Telling the Field from the Knower of the Field

verses.en: (The Blessed Lord said:) This body, Kaunteya (son of Kunti), is called the field. The one who knows it is called the knower of the field by those who understand these things.

cmp.note: kṣetra 就是田地，也是「圣地、场所」。全书第一句「在法的田野、俱卢之野」用的正是这个词，战场和身体在梵文里是同一个字。白话「田」、英文 field 都保住了字面，这层呼应要靠读者回想。
有些版本本章开头还有一首阿周那的提问（问原质、原人、田、知田者），全章就是 35 首。本站底本没有这一首，所以是 34 首，后面的编号会和那些版本差一号。

verses.en: Know me also as the knower of the field in all fields, Bharata. The knowledge of the field and of the knower of the field: that, in my view, is knowledge.
Hear from me in brief what that field is, what it is like, how it changes and where it comes from; and who the knower is, and what powers he has.
The seers have sung of this in many ways, in many separate meters, and also in the words of the Brahma Sutras, well reasoned and decisive.

cmp.note: 可以指后来那部有名的《梵经》，也可以只是泛指「讲梵的格言」。《梵经》成书很可能比这一段晚，所以学者多取后一种。白话写「梵经」、英文写 Brahma Sutras，都偏向了书名的读法。

verses.en: The great elements, the sense of 'I', understanding, the unmanifest, the ten senses and the one, and the five realms of the senses;

cmp.note: 这一串是数论派（Sāṃkhya）的标准清单：五大、我慢、觉、未显、十根加意、五境。白话照着术语译，像一份名词表；英文用了平常的词，读起来懂，但看不出这是一套专门体系。「十种加一」里的「一」就是心意 manas。

verses.en: desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, the bodily whole, awareness and steadiness: this, in brief, is the field with its changes.
Freedom from pride, freedom from pretense, nonviolence, patience, honesty, serving one's teacher, purity, steadiness, self-mastery;
turning away from the objects of the senses, freedom from the sense of 'I', and seeing clearly the trouble in birth, death, old age, sickness and pain;

cmp.note: vairāgya 由 vi-rāga 来：rāga 是「颜色、染上的热情」，vairāgya 就是「褪了色」。白话「没有贪恋」、英文 turning away 都译出了意思，丢了「褪色」这个画面。

verses.en: not clinging, not being wrapped up in children, wife, home and the like, and keeping an even mind always, whether what comes is wanted or unwanted;
unwavering devotion to me through a yoga that turns to nothing else, a liking for solitary places, and no taste for crowds;

cmp.note: vyabhicāra 在梵文里常指「不贞、出轨」。avyabhicāriṇī 是「不出轨的」，用的是夫妻忠贞的比喻。白话「毫不动摇」、英文 unwavering 都把这个比喻抹平了。

verses.en: constancy in knowledge of the self, and keeping in view what knowledge of the truth is for: this is called knowledge; whatever is otherwise is ignorance.

cmp.note: 从第七首到这里，「知识」指的是一长串品行：谦虚、不伤害、忍耐……而不是书本学问。梵文 jñāna 本来就包括「活出来的懂」。白话「知识」、英文 knowledge 都容易被读成头脑里的东西。

verses.en: I will tell you what is to be known, knowing which one tastes deathlessness: the highest Brahman, without beginning, which is said to be neither being nor non-being.

cmp.note: brahman 原指吠陀祭祀里有力量的话语，后来指一切背后那个终极实在。白话音译「梵」，英文保留 Brahman，都没有硬找一个对应词，这是对的。要和创世神「梵天」Brahmā 分开。
这几个字还可以断成 anādi mat-paraṃ：「无始的、以我为至高的梵」。白话和英文都取了常见断法，另一种断法会让梵在克里希那之下。

verses.en: Its hands and feet are everywhere; its eyes, heads and mouths are everywhere; it has ears everywhere in the world. It stands, enfolding everything.
It shines with the qualities of all the senses, yet has no senses at all; unattached, yet it upholds all; free of the gunas, yet it experiences the gunas.

cmp.note: guṇa 本义是「股、线」，三根线拧成一股绳：明（sattva）、动（rajas）、暗（tamas），万物都由这三股编成。本站英文第一次写 the three qualities (gunas)；白话这里写「属性」，下文又写「三德」，同一个词前后换了说法，读者容易以为是两回事。

verses.en: It is outside beings and inside them, unmoving and moving. Because it is so subtle it cannot be grasped; it is far away, and it is near.
Undivided, it yet seems to stand divided among beings. Know it as the sustainer of beings, the one that swallows them and the one that brings them forth.
It is the light of lights, said to lie beyond darkness. It is knowledge, what is to be known, and what knowledge reaches, seated in the heart of everyone.
So the field, and knowledge, and what is to be known have been briefly told. My devotee who understands this comes into my state of being.
Know that nature (prakriti) and the person (purusha) are both without beginning; and know that the changes and the three qualities (gunas) arise from nature.

cmp.note: 这是数论的一对概念：prakṛti 是会变的一切材料，连心理活动都算在里面；puruṣa 是只看不做的那个觉知。白话「原质」「原人」是学术译名，英文 nature、person 是普通词，读起来亲切，但 nature 容易被想成「大自然」。

verses.en: Nature is said to be the cause in the making of body, senses and agency; the person is said to be the cause in the experiencing of pleasure and pain.
For the person, dwelling in nature, experiences the qualities born of nature. Its clinging to the qualities is the cause of its births in good and bad wombs.

cmp.note: 动词 bhuj 本义是「吃」，引申为「受用、经历」。白话「享受」听起来是好事，可这里苦也算在里面；英文 experiences 比较中性。

verses.en: The highest person in this body is also called the onlooker, the one who consents, the upholder, the experiencer, the great Lord, and the supreme self.
Whoever knows the person, and nature together with its qualities, in this way will not be born again, however he may live.
Some see the self in the self by the self, through meditation; others through the yoga of discernment; and others through the yoga of action.

cmp.note: 梵文连用三个 ātman：「在自己里、看见自己、凭着自己」，像绕口令。白话拆成「凭自己在自己里面看见自我」，英文照字序写 the self in the self by the self，保住了重复的节奏。
这里的 sāṃkhya 字面是「计数、辨析」，指靠理智一项项分清的路，不一定是后来那个成型的数论学派。白话写「数论」，英文写 the yoga of discernment。

verses.en: Others again, not knowing this, hear it from others and worship; they too, giving themselves to what they have heard, pass beyond death.
Whatever comes into being, Bharatarshabha (bull of the Bharatas), whether still or moving, know that it arises from the union of the field and the knower of the field.
Whoever sees the supreme Lord dwelling alike in all beings, not perishing when they perish, truly sees.
For seeing the Lord present alike everywhere, he does not harm the self by the self, and so he goes to the highest goal.
Whoever sees that all actions are done, in every way, by nature alone, and likewise sees that the self is not the doer, truly sees.
When he sees that the separate existence of beings rests in the One, and spreads out from that alone, then he attains Brahman.
Being without beginning and without qualities, this supreme self does not decay. Though it dwells in the body, Kaunteya, it neither acts nor is stained.
Just as space, which reaches everywhere, is not stained because it is so subtle, so the self, present everywhere in the body, is not stained.
As the one sun lights up this whole world, so the master of the field lights up the whole field, Bharata.

cmp.note: 这里换了一个词：kṣetrin「田的主人」，不是前面的 kṣetrajña「知田者」。白话仍写「知田者」，把两个词并成一个；英文写 master of the field，保留了「主人」。

verses.en: Those who, with the eye of knowledge, see the difference between the field and the knower of the field, and the freeing of beings from nature, go to the highest.

chapters.title: Chapter 14 · Telling the Three Qualities Apart

verses.en: (The Blessed Lord said:) Let me tell you once more the highest knowledge, the best of all knowing. Every sage who came to know it went on from this world to the highest perfection.
Relying on this knowledge, they came to share my own nature. When a world is created they are not born again, and when it dissolves they are not shaken.
Great Brahman is my womb. Into it I place the seed, and from that, Bharata (Arjuna, descendant of King Bharata), all beings come to be.

cmp.note: 这里的 brahman 不是后面说的那个终极实在，而是指「原质」(prakṛti)，也就是一切生出来的东西的母体。英文照字面写 great Brahman，中文写「伟大的梵」，读者容易以为黑天把至高的梵当成了自己的子宫；其实他是在说：物质世界是母亲，我是父亲。

verses.en: Kaunteya (son of Kunti), whatever forms take birth in any womb, great Brahman is the womb of them all, and I am the father who gives the seed.

Sattva, rajas and tamas: these are the three qualities (gunas) that arise from nature (prakriti). Sattva is clarity and goodness, rajas is passion and restlessness, tamas is dullness and inertia. Mighty-armed one, these three tie the undying one who lives in the body to the body.

cmp.note: guṇa 本义是「一股线、一条绳」，所以下一句马上说它们「捆绑」人，原文里的比喻是连着的。英文 quality、中文「德」都把这层绳子的意思丢了。中文「德」还容易让人想到「道德」，其实三德并不都是好品质。
本站白话直接音译成「萨埵、罗阇、多摩」，不替它们下定义；常见的中文意译「善性、激性、惰性」，英文常见 goodness / passion / darkness，都只抓住一面。sattva 字面是「存在、真实」，引申为明亮清澈；rajas 原指「尘土、雾气」，引申为躁动；tamas 就是「黑暗」。本站英文保留原词，第一次各配两个词说明。

verses.en: Of these, sattva, being spotless, gives light and brings no harm. Yet it binds too, sinless one: through attachment to happiness and attachment to knowing.

cmp.note: 很多人以为 sattva 是「好的那一种」，修到它就对了。这一句说得很清楚：sattva 一样在捆人，只是用的是快乐和知识这两根比较舒服的绳子。英文和中文都照实译出了「束缚」，读的时候别滑过去。

verses.en: Know that rajas is made of craving; it springs from thirst and clinging. It binds the embodied one, son of Kunti, through attachment to action.
But tamas, know this, is born of ignorance and bewilders everyone who has a body. It binds, Bharata, through carelessness, laziness and sleep.
Sattva ties you to happiness, rajas to action, Bharata. Tamas covers over knowing and ties you to carelessness.
Sattva comes out on top by overpowering rajas and tamas, Bharata. In the same way rajas rises by overpowering sattva and tamas, and tamas by overpowering sattva and rajas.
When the light of knowing shines out through every gate of this body, then you can tell that sattva has grown strong.

cmp.note: 原文只说「所有的门」，没说是哪些门。古人通常理解为眼耳口鼻等九个孔窍。中文白话加了括号「感官」把意思点明；英文照原文留下 gates 这个画面。

verses.en: When rajas grows strong, best of the Bharatas, these arise: greed, busyness, rushing into new undertakings, restlessness and longing.
When tamas grows strong, joy of the Kurus, these arise: darkness, sluggishness, carelessness and confusion.
If the embodied one meets death while sattva is high, he reaches the pure worlds of those who know the highest.
Dying in rajas, he is born among people attached to action. Dying in tamas, he is born from the wombs of the dull-witted.
The fruit of a deed well done, they say, is of sattva and spotless. The fruit of rajas is pain, and the fruit of tamas is ignorance.
From sattva comes knowledge; from rajas, greed; from tamas come carelessness and confusion, and ignorance as well.
Those who stand in sattva go upward. Those of rajas stay in the middle. Those of tamas, living in the lowest quality, go downward.
When the one who watches sees no doer other than the qualities, and knows what lies beyond the qualities, he comes into my state of being.

cmp.note: 这是全书一个反直觉的想法：真正在「做事」的是三德，不是那个看着的自我。英文 no doer other than the qualities、中文「除了三德以外再没有别的行动者」都照直译了，意思是：认出「不是我在做」，人就松开了。

verses.en: Going beyond these three qualities, from which the body itself arises, the embodied one is freed from birth, death, old age and sorrow, and tastes what does not die.

cmp.note: amṛta 既是「不死」，也是神话里喝了就不死的「甘露」；aśnute 是「吃、享用」。所以原文有一层「喝到甘露」的画面。中文「尝到不死」、英文 tastes what does not die 都想同时保住这两层。

verses.en: (Arjuna said:) Lord, by what signs is a person known who has gone beyond these three qualities? How does he live? And how does he get past the three?
(The Blessed Lord said:) Son of Pandu, when light, activity or confusion come, he does not resent them; when they go, he does not long for them.
He sits like someone looking on from outside, not shaken by the qualities. Knowing "it is only the qualities at work," he stays steady and does not waver.

cmp.note: udāsīna 字面是「坐在高处的人」，指在争执里不站队的中立者。它不是冷漠，而是不被卷进去。中文「旁观者」稍微带点事不关己的味道，英文 looking on from outside 也一样，原意更中性。

verses.en: Pain and pleasure are the same to him, and he rests in himself; a lump of clay, a stone and gold are all one to him. He is steady, and treats the pleasant and the unpleasant alike, blame and praise of himself alike.

cmp.note: svastha 字面是「住在自己里面」，后来在梵文和印地语里变成了日常词「健康」。中文「安住于自身」、英文 rests in himself 都取字面；其实原文暗含着：回到自己，就是健康。

verses.en: Honor and disgrace are equal to him, the side of friends and the side of enemies equal. He has given up every self-driven undertaking. Such a person is said to have gone beyond the qualities.
And whoever serves me with the unwavering yoga of devotion goes fully beyond these qualities and becomes fit to become Brahman.

cmp.note: bhakti 来自「分享、分得一份」，指人和神之间彼此相属的爱。英文 devotion 偏向「献身、忠诚」，中文「虔爱」把「虔诚」和「爱」合在一起，比单说「信仰」更接近原文的亲密感。

verses.en: For I am the ground of Brahman, of the undying and unchanging, of the eternal dharma (the rightful order of things), and of perfect happiness.
The Blessed Lord said: They speak of an undying ashvattha tree (the sacred fig) with its roots above and its branches below. Its leaves are the Vedic hymns. Whoever knows this tree knows the Vedas.

cmp.note: aśvattha 是菩提树那一类的圣无花果树，中文用的是另一个名字「毕钵罗树」，佛经读者会联想到佛陀成道的树。古代注家还把这个词拆成「活不到明天」，用来说世界无常；可这里偏偏又说它「永不毁灭」，原文的张力在中英文里都看不出来。
chandas 原指吠陀诗的「格律」，后来泛指吠陀颂诗。中文「诗篇」、英文 hymns 都取了后一个意思。

verses.en: Its branches spread downward and upward, fed by the qualities, with the objects of the senses for their young shoots. Below, its roots stretch on and on, bound up with action in the world of humans.
Its true shape cannot be seen here, nor its end, nor its beginning, nor what it stands on. Take this firmly rooted ashvattha tree and cut it down with the strong blade of non-attachment.

cmp.note: śastra 是泛称的「刀、兵器」。中文白话说成「斧头」，画面更具体，像在砍树；英文用 blade，贴近原文那种不指定工具的说法。

verses.en: Then seek out that place from which those who reach it never return, saying: "I take refuge in that first Person, from whom this ancient stream of activity flowed out."

cmp.note: puruṣa 本义就是「人、男人」，在《梨俱吠陀》里是那个被献祭、身体化成世界的「原初巨人」。中文「原人」保住了这层神话；英文 Person 太日常，所以本站第一次加注 spirit。注意这里的 puruṣa 和数论里与原质相对的「神我」用的是同一个词。

verses.en: Free of pride and delusion, having beaten the fault of clinging, always turned toward the self, desires fallen away, released from the pairs of opposites called pleasure and pain, the undeluded go to that unchanging place.
No sun lights it, no moon, no fire. Those who go there do not come back. That is my highest home.
A part of my own self, eternal, becomes the living soul in the world of the living. It draws to itself the senses, with the mind as the sixth, which rest in nature.

cmp.note: aṃśa 是「一份、一部分」，像从整块里分出来的一份。中文、英文都译成「部分」；原文的意思是：每个个体生命都是神的一份，不是神造出来的另一样东西。

verses.en: Whenever this lord takes on a body, and whenever he leaves one, he takes these along and goes, the way the wind carries scents from where they lie.

cmp.note: āśaya 是「停放处、所在」。中文白话说成「花丛」，比喻更好懂；英文 from where they lie 照原文留空，让读者自己补上是花还是别的什么。

verses.en: Presiding over hearing, sight, touch, taste and smell, and the mind too, he enjoys the things of the senses.
Whether he is leaving or staying, or enjoying while joined to the qualities, the deluded do not see him. Those with the eye of knowledge do.
Yogis who strive see him settled within themselves. Those whose selves are unformed and who lack awareness do not see him, even if they strive.
The radiance in the sun that lights the whole world, the radiance in the moon and in fire: know that radiance is mine.
Entering the earth, I hold up all beings with my strength. And becoming soma, rich in sap, I nourish all the plants.

cmp.note: soma 既是祭祀用的神圣饮料，也是「月亮」的名字；古印度人相信月亮把汁液洒给草木。中文音译「苏摩」、英文 soma 都只剩饮料这一面，看不出它和上一句「月亮的光辉」是连着的。

verses.en: Becoming Vaishvanara, the fire of digestion, I dwell in the bodies of living things, and joined with the in-breath and the out-breath, I digest the four kinds of food.

cmp.note: vaiśvānara 原意是「属于一切人的」火，是吠陀里火神的一个称号。中文白话直接意译成「消化之火」，英文保留原名再说明。四种食物，注家一般说是嚼的、吮的、舔的、喝的。

verses.en: I am seated in the heart of everyone. From me come memory, knowledge, and their loss. I am what all the Vedas seek to know; I am the maker of Vedanta and the knower of the Vedas.

cmp.note: vedānta 字面是「吠陀的终点」，最早指附在吠陀最后的奥义书，不一定是后来的哲学派别。中文「吠檀多的创立者」容易让人想到一个学派的祖师；英文 Vedanta 也有同样的问题。

verses.en: There are two persons in this world, the perishable and the imperishable. All beings are the perishable; the one that stands firm like an anvil is called the imperishable.

cmp.note: kūṭa 是铁匠的砧子，kūṭastha 是「像砧子一样立着」：上面怎么敲打，它自己不动。中文「恒常不动者」只给了意思，英文保留了砧子这个画面。

verses.en: But there is another, the highest Person, called the supreme self, who enters the three worlds and holds them up, the unchanging Lord.
Since I am beyond the perishable and higher even than the imperishable, in the world and in the Veda I am celebrated as the Highest Person (Purushottama).

cmp.note: puruṣa + uttama，「人中最高的」。本章名就从这里来。中文「至上原人」、英文 Highest Person 都对得上；只是原文这个词在日常里也可以是对优秀男子的赞美，带着一点亲切感。

verses.en: Whoever, free of delusion, knows me in this way as the Highest Person knows all, Bharata, and loves me with his whole being.
So I have told you this most secret teaching, sinless one. Understanding it, a person becomes truly wise and has done all there is to do, Bharata.

cmp.note: 原文是同一个词根的文字游戏：「懂了(buddhvā)，就成了懂的人(buddhimān)」。中英文都没办法保住这个回声。kṛta-kṛtya 字面是「该做的都做完了」，中文「完成了一生该做的事」很贴切。

chapters.title: Chapter 16 · The Divine and the Demonic Inheritance

verses.en: (The Blessed Lord said:) Fearlessness, a clean heart, steadiness in the yoga of knowledge, giving, self-restraint, sacrifice, study of scripture, discipline, honesty,

cmp.note: tapas 本义是「热」，指通过修炼在自己身上生起的一股热力。中文「苦行」强调受苦，英文 austerity 也偏向「刻苦」。原文的重点不在吃苦，而在磨炼出力量，所以本站英文这里用了较中性的 discipline。

verses.en: not harming, truthfulness, freedom from anger, letting go, calm, not slandering, kindness to all beings, freedom from greed, gentleness, modesty, steadiness,
vigor, forgiveness, endurance, purity, lack of malice, freedom from excessive pride: these, Bharata, belong to one born into the divine inheritance.

cmp.note: saṃpad 是「财产、家当」。原文的画面是：人生下来就继承了一份家当，有的是神性的，有的是魔性的。中文「禀赋」偏向天生的性格，英文用 inheritance 保住了「分到一份家产」的意思。

verses.en: Hypocrisy, arrogance, excessive pride, anger, harshness and ignorance, Partha (son of Pritha), belong to one born into the demonic inheritance.
The divine inheritance is held to lead to freedom, the demonic to bondage. Don't grieve, son of Pandu: you were born into the divine inheritance.
There are two kinds of beings created in this world, the divine and the demonic. I have spoken about the divine at length; now hear from me about the demonic, Partha.

cmp.note: asura 在吠陀神话里是和天神争位的另一族神灵，不是基督教里的魔鬼。中文「魔性」、英文 demonic 都比原文更像「恶魔」。黑天说的其实是两种人的性情，不是两种物种。

verses.en: Demonic people do not understand when to act and when to hold back. There is no purity in them, no good conduct, no truth.

cmp.note: 这一对词是「向外投入」和「向内收回」，在印度思想里也指入世行动和出世修行两条路。中文白话译成「什么该做、什么不该做」，英文译成 when to act and when to hold back，都是取了其中的一层。

verses.en: They say the world is unreal, has no foundation, has no Lord, has come about from things joining one another, with nothing but desire for its cause. What else could it be?

cmp.note: 这几个字很难解，字面大约是「不是彼此…而生的」。传统注家多半读成「由男女结合而生」，中文白话照这个读法加了括号；英文只写「由东西相互结合而来」，不替原文补上男女。

verses.en: Holding to this view, these lost souls of little understanding, doing cruel deeds, rise up as enemies of the world, bent on its ruin.
Clinging to desire that can never be filled, full of hypocrisy, pride and intoxication, they seize on false notions out of delusion and go about their work with impure vows.
Weighed down by endless worry that ends only at death, treating the enjoyment of desire as the highest goal, sure that "this is all there is,"
bound by hundreds of ropes of hope, given over to desire and anger, they scheme to pile up wealth by unjust means so they can enjoy their desires.
"This I have gained today; that wish I will fulfill. This wealth is mine already, and that will be mine too."
"That enemy I have killed, and I will kill the others as well. I am the lord, I am the enjoyer, I am successful, strong and happy."
"I am rich and well born. Who else is like me? I will sacrifice, I will give, I will celebrate." So they talk, deluded by ignorance.

cmp.note: 有意思的是，这些「魔性」的人也说要祭祀、要布施，跟神性禀赋那张清单上的一样。差别不在做什么，而在为了什么：这里的祭祀和布施是拿来炫耀身份的。中英文都照原文保留了这个讽刺。

verses.en: Led astray by many thoughts, caught in the net of delusion, addicted to the enjoyment of desires, they fall into a foul hell.

cmp.note: naraka 在印度传统里是受苦的去处，但一般不是永远的，罪报完了还会再投生。中文「地狱」、英文 hell 都容易让读者想到基督教那种永远的惩罚。

verses.en: Self-important, stubborn, drunk with wealth and pride, they offer sacrifices in name only, for show, ignoring the rules.
Leaning on ego, force, arrogance, desire and anger, these spiteful people hate me, who dwell in their own bodies and in the bodies of others.

cmp.note: ahaṃkāra 字面是「造出『我』的那个东西」，在数论里是一个心理机能，不只是「骄傲」。中文白话借用了佛经的「我慢」，英文用 ego。两个译法都偏向道德上的自大，原词更像是：心里那个一直在说「我、我的」的声音。后面第十七、十八章还会出现，意思一样。

verses.en: Those hateful, cruel ones, the lowest of humans in the round of births, unclean as they are, I keep hurling into demonic wombs.
Having entered demonic wombs, deluded birth after birth, never reaching me, son of Kunti, they go from there to an even lower state.
There are three gates to hell that destroy the self: desire, anger and greed. So one should let go of these three.
A person freed from these three gates of darkness, son of Kunti, does what is truly good for himself, and from there goes to the highest goal.
Whoever throws aside the guidance of scripture and acts on the impulse of desire reaches neither perfection, nor happiness, nor the highest goal.
So let scripture be your measure in deciding what to do and what not to do. Knowing what the rules of scripture say, you should do your work here.

cmp.note: pramāṇa 是印度哲学里的「量」，也就是可靠知识的来源，像量尺一样。中文「准则」、英文 measure 都对。śāstra 在这里指吠陀与律法一类的典籍，不是泛指一切书。

verses.en: (Arjuna said:) Krishna, what about those who set aside the rules of scripture but still offer sacrifice full of faith? Where do they stand: in sattva, rajas or tamas?

cmp.note: śraddhā 常被译成「信仰」，但它不是相信某套教义，而是对一件事全心投入、信得过的那份心意，有点像「诚意加信任」。本站白话用「信心」，英文用 faith，都比「信仰」更接近。这一章整章讲它：你把心放在哪里，你就成了什么样的人。

verses.en: (The Blessed Lord said:) The faith of embodied beings is of three kinds, born from each one's own nature: of sattva, of rajas, and of tamas. Hear about it.
Everyone's faith takes the shape of their inner being, Bharata. A person is made of faith: whatever one's faith is, that is what one is.

cmp.note: 这里的 sattva 不是三德里的那个 sattva，而是它的本义「本性、心性」。中文白话译成「本性」，英文写 inner being，都避开了混淆；只看梵文的人很容易误读成「信心随 sattva 而定」。
-maya 是「由……构成」。原文说人「是信心做成的」，比中文「由信心构成」、英文 made of faith 读起来更直接：你相信什么，就是什么。

verses.en: People of sattva worship the gods; people of rajas worship yakshas and rakshasas (spirits of wealth and night-prowling demons); others, people of tamas, worship ghosts of the dead and hordes of spirits.

cmp.note: yakṣa 是守护财宝、半神半妖的精灵，佛经里的「夜叉」就是它；rakṣas 是吃人的夜间恶鬼，佛经译「罗刹」。中文白话用了「药叉」「罗刹」，英文只能音译加括号说明。

verses.en: Some people practice harsh austerities that scripture never prescribed, full of hypocrisy and ego, driven by desire, passion and brute force.
Foolish, they torment the elements that make up the body, and me too, who dwell inside the body. Know that their resolve is demonic.
Even the food each person likes is of three kinds, and so are sacrifice, austerity and giving. Hear how they differ.
Foods that increase life, vitality, strength, health, happiness and good cheer, that are juicy, rich, nourishing and pleasing to the heart, are dear to people of sattva.

cmp.note: snigdha 是「油润的」，在印度饮食里指加了酥油、奶这类滋养的东西，不是贬义的「油腻」。sthira 是「持久的」，指吃下去能顶得住。中文「油润、耐饱」很贴，英文换成 rich, nourishing。

verses.en: Foods that are pungent, sour, salty, too hot, sharp, dry and burning are liked by people of rajas; they bring pain, grief and illness.

cmp.note: 梵文 kaṭu 指辛辣、呛口的味道（像姜和胡椒），「苦」另有一个字 tikta。中文白话译成「苦的」，英文按原意译成 pungent。

verses.en: Food that has sat too long, lost its taste, gone putrid or stale, leftovers, and things unfit for offering are dear to people of tamas.

cmp.note: yāta-yāma 字面是「过了一个时辰（约三小时）」，就是放凉、放久了的饭。ucchiṣṭa 是别人吃剩的，在印度礼俗里沾了别人的口就不洁净。amedhya 是「不能拿去供神的」。中英文都只能把它们当成「不新鲜」，宗教上的洁净感淡了。

verses.en: Sacrifice offered according to the rules by those who seek no fruit, with the mind settled on the thought "this simply ought to be offered," is of sattva.
But sacrifice offered with an eye on its fruit, or for show, best of the Bharatas, know that it is of rajas.
Sacrifice with no regard for the rules, with no food given out, without mantras, without the fee for the priests, and without faith, is called tamas.

cmp.note: dakṣiṇā 是祭祀结束时给主祭婆罗门的酬金，没有它，祭祀在规矩上就不算完成。中文「不给祭司酬金」、英文 without the fee for the priests 都照实译了。

verses.en: Honoring the gods, the twice-born, teachers and the wise; purity, honesty, chastity and not harming: this is called the austerity of the body.

cmp.note: dvija「再生者」指受过成年圣线礼的上三个种姓，尤其指婆罗门。brahmacarya 字面是「行于梵」，实际指独身、禁欲的修行；中文「梵行」保住了字面，英文 chastity 只说了实际含义。

verses.en: Words that cause no distress, that are true, kind and helpful, along with regular recitation of scripture: this is called the austerity of speech.
A clear and serene mind, gentleness, silence, self-control and purity of heart: this is called the austerity of the mind.
When people practice this threefold austerity with the highest faith, seeking no fruit and with disciplined minds, it is called sattva.
Austerity done to win respect, honor and reverence, or done for show, is called rajas here; it is unsteady and does not last.
Austerity done out of foolish stubbornness, by torturing oneself, or meant to ruin someone else, is called tamas.
A gift given because "it ought to be given," to someone who cannot repay it, at the right place and time, to a worthy recipient, is held to be of sattva.

cmp.note: pātra 本义是「容器、碗」，引申为「配得上接受的人」。古人的想法是：给出去的东西要放进合适的容器里。中英文都只译出了引申义。

verses.en: But a gift given to get something back, or with an eye on some fruit, or given grudgingly, is held to be of rajas.
A gift given at the wrong place and time, to the unworthy, without courtesy and with contempt, is called tamas.
"Om tat sat": this is remembered as the threefold naming of Brahman. By it, long ago, the brahmins, the Vedas and the sacrifices were set in place.

cmp.note: tat 是「那个」，sat 是「存在、真实、善」。中文白话译成「彼、真」，英文保留原音，后面三颂再逐个解释。本站梵文这一颂只录了 tat sad，但下一颂马上讲 om，传统上三个字连在一起念，所以中英文都把「唵」补上了。

verses.en: That is why those who speak of Brahman always say "Om" first when they begin acts of sacrifice, giving and austerity as the rules prescribe.
Saying "tat" (that), without aiming at any fruit, those who long for freedom perform the various acts of sacrifice, austerity and giving.
"Sat" is used to mean what is real and what is good; and the word "sat" is also used, Partha, for a praiseworthy deed.

cmp.note: 一个字同时是「存在的、真实的」和「好的」，在梵文里很自然：真的就是好的。中文白话用一个「真」字，英文要拆成 real 和 good 两个词，谁也没法用一个字装下两个意思。

verses.en: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity and giving is also called "sat," and any action done for their sake is likewise called "sat."
Whatever is offered, given, practiced as austerity or done without faith is called "asat" (unreal), Partha. It counts for nothing, either after death or here.

cmp.note: asat 是 sat 的反面：「不存在、不真实、没价值」。中文「非真」、英文 unreal 都只取了一面；原文的意思是，没有信心做的事等于没做过。

verses.en: Arjuna said: Mighty-armed one, Hrishikesha (lord of the senses), slayer of the demon Keshi, I want to know the truth about renunciation and about letting go, each on its own.

cmp.note: 这一章的主线就是这两个词。saṃnyāsa 是「整个放下」，后来专指出家、抛开社会身份；tyāga 是「松手、舍掉」，重点在不抓着结果。本站中文用「出离 / 舍弃」，英文用 renunciation / letting go。黑天接下来的回答是：真正要做的是 tyāga，事情照做，只是放开果报。

verses.en: The Blessed Lord said: The wise understand renunciation as setting aside actions done out of desire. The discerning call letting go the giving up of the fruits of all action.

cmp.note: kāmya 是吠陀里一类专门「为了求某样东西」而做的祭祀，比如求子、求雨、求升天。中文「出于欲求的行为」、英文 actions done out of desire 都把这层仪式背景冲淡了。

verses.en: Some thinkers say action should be given up because it is flawed in itself. Others say acts of sacrifice, giving and austerity should not be given up.
Hear my conclusion on letting go, best of the Bharatas. Letting go, tiger among men, has been declared to be of three kinds.
Acts of sacrifice, giving and austerity should not be given up; they should be done. Sacrifice, giving and austerity purify the wise.
But even these actions should be done letting go of attachment and of their fruits. That, Partha, is my settled and highest view.
Renouncing an action that is one's duty is not right. Abandoning it out of confusion is called letting go of the tamas kind.

cmp.note: niyata 是「被规定的、固定的」，指按身份每天、每年必须做的那些事。中文「规定的义务」、英文 an action that is one's duty 都对，但原文更像「排定的功课」，不是道德上的义务感。

verses.en: Whoever drops an action as merely "painful," for fear of bodily strain, performs a letting go of the rajas kind and does not get the fruit of letting go.
When one does a required action simply because "it should be done," Arjuna, letting go of attachment and fruit, that letting go is held to be of sattva.
The one who lets go, filled with sattva, wise, with doubts cut away, does not hate unpleasant work and does not cling to pleasant work.

cmp.note: kuśala 原义是「熟练的、合宜的」，佛经里译作「善」、「不善」。这里中文白话取「愉快、不愉快」，英文也一样，没有用道德上的「好、坏」。

verses.en: No one with a body can give up action completely. The one who lets go of the fruits of action is the one called a person of letting go.
Unwanted, wanted, and mixed: these are the three kinds of fruit of action that come after death to those who have not let go, but never to those who have renounced.
Mighty-armed one, learn from me these five factors taught in the Sankhya doctrine for the accomplishment of every action.

cmp.note: sāṃkhya 字面是「计数」，指把世界一项项数清楚的那派学问，中文译「数论」。kṛtānta 是「已经下了定论的教义」。这里不一定是后来成形的数论学派，也可能只是「分析的学问」。

verses.en: The seat (the body), the doer, the various instruments, the many different kinds of effort, and fifth, providence.

cmp.note: daiva 字面是「属于神的」，指人管不到的那一份因素。中文「天意」、英文 providence 都带着「有一位神在安排」的意思；原文更模糊，也可以理解成命运、运气。

verses.en: Whatever action a person starts with body, speech or mind, right or wrong, these five are its causes.
That being so, whoever sees himself alone as the doer, because his understanding is unformed, does not see; his mind is dull.
One who has no sense of "I did it," whose understanding is untainted, even if he kills these people, does not kill and is not bound.
Knowledge, the known, and the knower are the threefold prompt to action. The instrument, the act and the doer are the threefold makeup of action.
Knowledge, action and the doer are each said to be of three kinds, by the difference of the qualities, in the teaching that counts the qualities. Hear about these too, as they are.
The knowledge by which one sees a single unchanging being in all beings, undivided among the divided, know that knowledge is of sattva.
But the knowledge that sees in all beings only separate entities of different kinds, each apart, know that knowledge is of rajas.
And the knowledge that clings to a single task as if it were the whole, without reason, missing what is real, and narrow, is called tamas.
Action that is required, done without attachment, without liking or disliking, by someone who wants no fruit, is called sattva.
But action done by someone chasing their desires, or full of ego, with great strain, is called rajas.
Action begun out of delusion, without regard for consequences, loss, harm to others, or one's own capacity, is called tamas.
A doer free of attachment, who doesn't talk about "I," full of steadiness and energy, unchanged by success or failure, is called sattva.
A doer full of craving, eager for the fruits of action, greedy, harmful by nature, impure, swinging between joy and grief, is declared to be of rajas.
A doer who is undisciplined, crude, stubborn, deceitful, mean, lazy, gloomy and always putting things off is called tamas.

cmp.note: 字面是「线拉得很长的人」，就是做事拖拖拉拉、一拖再拖。中文「拖拖拉拉」和英文 always putting things off 都恰好对上，原文的比喻很生动。

verses.en: Now hear, Dhananjaya (winner of wealth), the threefold difference in understanding and in steadfastness according to the qualities, explained fully and one by one.

cmp.note: buddhi 是做判断、下决定的那部分心，本站英文统一译 understanding，中文白话这里用「智慧」，听起来比原文高一档。dhṛti 是「撑住、守住」的能力，中英文都译成「坚持」，接下来三颂讲三种不同的坚持。

verses.en: The understanding that knows when to act and when to stop, what should be done and what should not, what to fear and what not to fear, what binds and what frees, Partha, is of sattva.
The understanding by which one knows dharma and its opposite, what should be done and what should not, but not as they really are, Partha, is of rajas.

cmp.note: 中文白话用佛教味的「正法、非法」，英文这里保留 dharma（本段第一次出现在第十四章末，注成 the rightful order of things）。dharma 在《薄伽梵歌》里既是社会本分，也是宇宙秩序，「法」字很难同时装下这两层。

verses.en: The understanding that, wrapped in darkness, takes adharma for dharma and sees everything backwards, Partha, is of tamas.
The steadfastness with which, through unwavering yoga, one holds in check the workings of the mind, the breath and the senses, Partha, is of sattva.
But the steadfastness with which one holds on to dharma, pleasure and wealth, Arjuna, craving their fruit as each comes along, Partha, is of rajas.

cmp.note: 这是印度传统里人生的三个正当目标：本分、欲乐、财富，加上第四个「解脱」就是四大人生目的。中文「正法、欲乐和财利」逐个对上；英文读者看不出这是一组固定说法。

verses.en: The steadfastness with which a dull person will not let go of sleep, fear, grief, despair and arrogance, Partha, is of tamas.
And now hear from me, bull of the Bharatas, about the three kinds of happiness. The happiness one comes to enjoy through practice, and in which pain comes to an end,
which is like poison at first but like nectar in the end, born from the clarity of one's own understanding of the self, is called happiness of sattva.
The happiness that comes from the senses meeting their objects, like nectar at first but like poison in the end, is held to be of rajas.
The happiness that deludes the self both at the start and afterward, arising from sleep, laziness and carelessness, is called tamas.
There is no being, on earth or among the gods in heaven, that is free of these three qualities born of nature.

cmp.note: 这一颂的 sattva 又是本义「存在物、生灵」，不是三德之一。同一颂里一边说「没有哪个 sattva 能摆脱三德」，一边三德里也有 sattva，原文有点绕口；中文「存在」、英文 being 都把它解开了。

verses.en: Scorcher of foes, the work of brahmins (priests), kshatriyas (warriors and rulers), vaishyas (farmers and traders) and shudras (laborers) is divided according to the qualities that arise from their own nature.

cmp.note: 原文说四个阶层的职责是按「各人天性所生的德」来分的，没有直接说「按出身」。后世拿这一颂来为世袭种姓辩护，也有人用它来说「看性情不看血统」。中英文都照字面译，不替任何一方下结论。

verses.en: Calm, self-control, austerity, purity, patience, honesty, knowledge, wisdom and faith in the Veda: these are the work of a brahmin, born of his nature.

cmp.note: āstika 字面是「说『有』的人」，指承认吠陀权威、相信有来世的人。中文「对吠陀的信仰」、英文 faith in the Veda 都是取了它在这里的实际意思。

verses.en: Courage, vigor, endurance, skill, not fleeing in battle, generosity and the bearing of a leader: these are the work of a kshatriya, born of his nature.
Farming, tending cattle and trade are the work of a vaishya, born of his nature; work that consists in service is the work of a shudra, also born of his nature.
Each person who delights in their own work reaches perfection. Hear how one devoted to their own work finds perfection.
By worshiping, through one's own work, the one from whom all beings come forth and by whom all this is pervaded, a person finds perfection.
Better your own duty (svadharma) done imperfectly than another's duty done well. Doing the work set by your own nature, you incur no fault.

cmp.note: sva-dharma 是「自己的那份 dharma」，由你的天性和位置决定。中文白话译「自己的职责」，读起来像工作岗位；英文 your own duty 也偏向义务。原文更像：活出你自己那条路，哪怕走得不漂亮，也胜过把别人的路走得很好。第三章也说过同样的话。

verses.en: Son of Kunti, one should not give up the work one is born to, even if it has flaws. All undertakings are clouded by some flaw, as fire is by smoke.
With understanding unattached everywhere, self mastered, longing gone, through renunciation one reaches the highest perfection of freedom from action.

cmp.note: 字面是「没有行为的状态」，但前面一直在讲照样做事、只是放开果报，所以它指的是「做着却不被行为捆住」。中文白话借用道家的「无为」，意思接近，但会带进老庄的联想。

verses.en: Learn from me briefly, son of Kunti, how one who has reached perfection reaches Brahman, the highest state of knowledge.
Joined to a purified understanding, restraining oneself with steadiness, letting go of sound and the other objects of the senses, putting aside liking and disliking,
living in solitude, eating lightly, controlling speech, body and mind, always devoted to the yoga of meditation, resting in dispassion,
letting go of ego, force, arrogance, desire, anger and possessiveness, with no sense of "mine," at peace, one becomes fit to become Brahman.
Having become Brahman, serene within, one neither grieves nor craves. Equal toward all beings, one gains the highest devotion to me.
Through devotion one comes to know me truly, how great I am and who I am. Then, knowing me truly, one enters into me at once.
Even while always doing all kinds of actions, one who takes refuge in me reaches by my grace the eternal, unchanging place.

cmp.note: prasāda 本义是「清澈、平静」，也指神的「恩典」，还指供过神再分给人吃的食物。第三十七颂的「清明」和这里的「恩典」原文是同一个词，中英文分开译，读者看不出这种呼应。

verses.en: In your mind, hand over all actions to me. Make me your highest goal, rely on the yoga of understanding, and keep your thoughts always on me.
With your thoughts on me, you will cross over every difficulty by my grace. But if out of ego you will not listen, you will be lost.
If, leaning on ego, you think "I will not fight," your resolve is useless: your own nature will make you do it.
Son of Kunti, you are bound by your own work, born of your nature. What you do not want to do out of confusion, you will do anyway, even against your will.
The Lord lives in the heart of every being, Arjuna, and by his power of illusion (maya) he keeps all beings spinning, as if mounted on a machine.

cmp.note: māyā 原指「神奇的造化力、魔术」，后来才偏向「幻象」。中文「幻力」、英文 power of illusion 都偏后一个意思。yantra 是「机关、器械」，画面像是众生坐在一台转动的机器上；中文白话加了「转动的」，把画面说完整了。

verses.en: Go to him alone for refuge, with your whole being, Bharata. By his grace you will reach the highest peace and the eternal home.
So I have told you this knowledge, more secret than any secret. Think it through completely, then do as you choose.

cmp.note: 讲了十八章之后，黑天没有下命令，而是说「想透了，照你愿意的去做」。中英文都照直译出来，这是整部对话里很少见的、把选择交还给对方的一句。

verses.en: Hear once more my highest word, the most secret of all: you are dearly loved by me, so I will tell you what is good for you.
Keep your mind on me, be devoted to me, worship me, bow to me. You will come to me; I promise you truly, for you are dear to me.
Let go of all dharmas and come to me alone for refuge. I will free you from every wrong. Do not grieve.

cmp.note: 这里 dharma 是复数「一切的法」，指各种宗教规矩、身份义务。中文白话「放下一切法」保留了原字；英文留下 dharmas。这一句和第四十七颂「自己的本分胜过别人的」放在一起读很有张力，历代注家对它的解释争论最多。
pāpa 是「坏的、带来恶果的东西」，不一定是宗教意义上的「罪」。中文「罪」、英文 sin 都太重，本站英文用 wrong。

verses.en: Never speak of this to anyone without discipline, without devotion, or unwilling to listen, nor to anyone who resents me.
Whoever teaches this highest secret to those devoted to me, having shown the highest devotion to me, will come to me without doubt.
No one among humans does me a dearer service than such a person, and no one on earth will be dearer to me.
And whoever studies this conversation of ours, so true to dharma, will be worshiping me, I believe, with the sacrifice of knowledge.
Even one who just listens with faith and without resentment will be freed, and will reach the bright worlds of those whose deeds were good.
Partha, did you hear this with a focused mind? Dhananjaya, has your confusion, born of ignorance, been destroyed?
Arjuna said: My confusion is gone. Through your grace, Achyuta (the unfailing one), I have found my memory again. I stand firm, my doubts are gone. I will do as you say.

cmp.note: smṛti 是「记忆、想起来」，阿周那是说：我想起来自己是谁、该做什么了。中文白话译成「恢复了正念」，借了佛教「正念」这个词，读者会想到冥想；英文照字面写 memory。

verses.en: Sanjaya said: So I heard this wondrous conversation between Vasudeva (Krishna, son of Vasudeva) and the great-souled Partha, and it made my hair stand on end.
By the grace of Vyasa I heard this supreme secret, this yoga, from Krishna, the lord of yoga, speaking it himself before my very eyes.

cmp.note: 毗耶娑是《摩诃婆罗多》的作者，也是故事里的人物。他赐给桑遮耶「天眼」，让他在宫中就能看见、听见战场上的一切，所以桑遮耶说自己是「亲耳听到」。中英文没有交代这个背景，读到这里会有点突兀。

verses.en: O king, as I recall again and again this wondrous and holy conversation between Keshava and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.
And as I recall again and again that most wondrous form of Hari (Krishna), great is my amazement, O king, and I rejoice again and again.
Wherever there is Krishna, the lord of yoga, and wherever there is Partha, the archer, there, I am sure, are fortune, victory, prosperity and sound statecraft.

cmp.note: nīti 是「治国之道、策略」，偏向政治上的明智。中文白话译成「正道」，偏向道德；英文 sound statecraft 更贴原文。整句是桑遮耶对盲眼国王持国说的，其实是在委婉地预告：他儿子那一方会输。
